steps.text: Speak to King Roald in Varrock Castle.
Go to the temple east of Varrock by the river and click on the large door.
choices: Roald sent me to check on Drezel.

steps.text: Go down the ladder north of the temple.
Kill the Temple Guardian (level 30). It is immune to magic so you will need to use either ranged or melee.
Climb back up the ladder and return to King Roald.
Return to King Roald.
Return to the temple.
Kill a Monk of Zamorak (level 30) for a golden key. You can safespot using the pews.
Go upstairs.
Climb up the ladder.
Talk to Drezel on the top floor of the temple.
Use the bucket on the well in the central room.
Go to the central room, and study the monuments to find which has a key on it. Use the Golden Key on it.
Go down to the underground of the temple.
Go down to the underground of the temple.
Go down to the underground of the temple.
Go back up to the top floor of the temple.
Go back up to the top floor of the temple.
Go back up to the top floor of the temple.
Open the cell door.
Talk to Drezel to bless the water.
Use the blessed water on the coffin.
Talk to Drezel again.
Go down to the underground of the temple.
Go down to the underground of the temple.
Go down to the underground of the temple.
Talk to Drezel in the east of the underground temple area.
Bring Drezel 50 UNNOTED rune/pure essence in the underground of the Salve Temple to finish the quest!
